Survey title: Gaza SMART Survey 2026: Nutritional Status of Women and Children in the Gaza Strip, final report
Lead organization: UNICEF State of Palestine, with the Nutrition Cluster, Action Against Hunger and the Gaza SMART TWG
Geographic coverage: Gaza Strip, accessible areas (about 17% of the population excluded): 3 domains (Gaza and North Gaza, Deir Al-Balah, Khan Yunis and Rafah) + weighted Gaza Strip estimate
Notes: Final report June 2026. Tables are images (no text layer): values read from the rendered pages and checked against OCR. No mortality. No n or N printed. WHZ and combined tables titled 0-59 months.
